nom: Dr. Melaxin Peel Shot Exfoliating Black Rice Ampoule

avis.texte: Not at all the hype is claiming but does work just not as good as I hoped.
I tried the white rice first, and I loved it and then I tried this one and what a difference it makes. It's amazing.
My skin is combination and sensitive. This helps with the blackhead and pore size. Leaves skin soft and is nonirritating. I use it twice a week to help keep my skin clean.
I have been getting regular facials, but my skin has never looked as clean or bright since using this product!
I don't think this actually does anything. The black stuff coming off is just the black stuff from the product, not from the blackheads.
Tiktok made this famous. Which is why I bought it. It doesnt work.

I have rosacea and sensitive, combo skin overall. I use this primarily for the blackheads on my nose and next to it, and ive gotten amazing results after only two uses! I wash my face, dry it, use the product on the areas i want, and rub GENTLY for a little less than a minute and follow thru with washing it off with warm water. Ive used it 2 days apart from each other and have gotten amazing results.

Ive been wanting to try this because of tiktok, i finally decided to buy it and i was shocked, gagged… no words. It actually cleaned my nose! I would still use sometbing for pore tightening but it will clean those suckers out! As a girly who goes to the gym alot I needed tlc on my pores! My husband even tried it and it worked for him too! 10/10 would recommend.
Left my skin red and scabbed over. I would not recommend if you have sensitive skin. I would probably recommend this more as a body shot, rather than for your face.

So proud of Ulta for adding this to their inventory!!!!!! I've been so reliant on this product. I am a minimalist when it comes to products on my face and this is a must have. I dont do make up, I dont do crazy facial routines but I know a product that clears all the dead skin cells when I see one. Seriously cant live with out this!

Absolutely love. I have had Rosacea for years and Dr. Melaxin products are amazing for it! Most exfoliating products make it worse, but this one is invasive without causing irritation. seriously, You won't regret it!

avis.titre: I probably wouldn't buy this again or recommend it
avis.texte: I heard all about this infamous peel shot, and to be honest it did take off my dead skin, and I think some of my blackheads. Sadly, though it made my face feel like a scab if that makes any sense and it burnt afterwards, even when I tried to put on my moisturizer. It made my face feel very dry afterwards. If it works for you, hallelujah, but it's sadly did not for me.

I have the worst t zone when it comes to dryness. I have a a constant dry nose and once i used this magic in a bottle…gone. It literally wiped away all of my dead skin and more and left my skin glowing and soft. I get excited more to do my skincare because of this product! It is literally magic and I will never stop using it!!!
Both the regular rice one and black rice one are the best products ive ever used

avis.titre: First review I've EVER written here
avis.texte: I cannot believe the junk that came out of my face with just one application of this. If you are thinking of trying Korean skincare like I was PLEASE buy this right now. I am so impressed. My boyfriend is a super masculine type and I caught him using this again in the bathroom today. He said he'd been trying to get his blackheads on his nose for a year with no luck and this stuff got them right out in 2 seconds. It's absolutely insane how good this stuff works. It leaves your face feeling soft and smooth and ready for moisturizer. I also have a slight glow on my face today that has never been there and have only used it once so far. I legit thought the ladies with skin like this were using some type of makeup. Just wow to this. I can't wait to try more products in this line.

I have never ever wrote a review on a product like this. But this is legit. Ive had a small, DEEP, blackhead on my nose for about a year, nothing i tried would get rid of it!! I used this product on my nose after washing my face, and the blackhead popped right out. FIRST USE. With a little force of course, but im almost positive the product helped it surface just enough for me to get it out. Im so relieved!! 100% recommend! Also made my skin suuper soft.
